answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before joining the economy. A new agent may wander in freely for tiny tasks, but high-value work goes only to bonded identities whose locked stake exceeds any single transaction's value. This is a costly signal: honest operators lock capital they cannot double-spend, while a sybil farmer must fund a bond per clone, making identities expensive. A random audit panel re-checks liveness each epoch; a detected clone cluster triggers a slashing gale that burns the attacker's bonds, so the attack destroys its own money.
